title: Information Retrieval, Search Indexing, Ranking, and Evaluation Foundations

sources.notes: Introduction to Information Retrieval companion site identity for Boolean retrieval, vocabulary/postings, tolerant retrieval, index construction/compression, scoring, vector-space ranking, search-system scoring, evaluation, relevance feedback, query expansion, XML retrieval, probabilistic retrieval, language models, classification, clustering, and latent semantic indexing; HTML/PDF chapters, figures, slides, assignments, and errata remain boundary-checked.

Apache Lucene identity for high-performance search-engine library features: structured/full-text search, faceting, vector nearest-neighbor search, spell correction, suggestions, indexing, ranked retrieval, query types, fielded search, multiple-index search, highlighting, joins, grouping, pluggable ranking, vector-space model, BM25, and codecs; docs, source code, benchmarks, APIs, and downloads remain boundary-checked.
Apache Lucene core API identity for implementation-facing search/indexing documentation; generated JavaDoc pages, package docs, source code, and examples remain boundary-checked.

Elasticsearch reference identity for a distributed search and analytics engine, scalable data store, vector database built on Lucene, near-real-time indexing/search/analysis, query languages, aggregations, geospatial analysis, machine learning, APIs, clients, security, monitoring, and production guidance; docs, examples, APIs, screenshots, and code remain boundary-checked.

NIST TREC identity for evaluation workshops measuring search algorithm effectiveness, IR/NLP research community, datasets, measurement processes, tools, tracks, participation agreements, and proceedings; datasets, proceedings, guidelines, topics, qrels, runs, images, and linked assets remain boundary-checked.
